rule: Unbound with every feature Optilux dropped switched off. Kept features are matched to Optilux's measured setting as each one lands (M4-M5); until then they keep their played value.
source: option names and values read from Complementary Reimagined r5.9.2 lib/common.glsl and lang/en_US.lang (ALC upstream/), 2026-10-05
verify: check every key and value against Unbound r5.9.3 before the first M2 capture; Unbound's style may change defaults

droppedNotes.RP_MODE: 0 = neither IPBR (1) nor custom PBR (2, 3); removes generated normals, coated textures, improved glass, green-screen lime, POM, normal maps and custom emission in one switch; the played settings already use 0
droppedNotes.COLORED_LIGHTING: 0 disables Advanced Color Tracing and its extras (colored light fog, connected glass, portal edges, puddle voxelization)

unresolved.RAIN_STYLE: no off value (1 or 2); played uses 2; ALC measured RAIN_STYLE=1 at -0.020 ms mean
unresolved.improvedWeatherTextures: no matching key in Reimagined r5.9.2 common.glsl; find it in Unbound r5.9.3
unresolved.AURORA_STYLE_DEFINE: values [-1 0 1 2]; -1 = the style's default; 0 assumed off
unresolved.bloom: played.json's ablation used BLOOM_ENABLED=-1; kept.keys names BLOOM_STRENGTH; confirm which switch exists in Unbound r5.9.3 and use one key in both files

kept.why: Unbound's switch for each feature Optilux keeps; set to match Optilux's setting in the measurement
